claims.claim: Canonical family admission consumes one exact FamilyMergeDecisionRecord and one explicit opaque caller-supplied family_id, permits only explicit Human APPROVE, validates family_id fail-closed, and preserves every accepted family_id exactly without generation or normalization.

The immutable canonical family record preserves the approved proposal member tuple in its existing canonical order and retains the exact Human decision record and all relationship evidence as unchanged approval provenance without asserting transitive sellable-variant identity.

Canonical family construction is deterministic and side-effect-free, performs no resolution, grouping, or proposal re-execution, generates no identity, and introduces no product, variant, profile, persistence, catalog, or external-service behavior.

Focused regressions cover approved admission, fail-closed rejection and type handling, exact family_id validation and preservation, exact immutable membership and provenance, deterministic construction, boundary isolation, absence of generated or variant identity, and zero persistence or external side effects while retaining TASK-112 behavior.
